title: Yoisaki Kanade — The Best Specialty Shop In Town〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: The Best Specialty Shop In Town（4★）
meta.Event: Hope Will Someday Go Beyond the Morning

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <A bakery that sells good apple pies?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, Ms. Mochizuki... I mean, my housekeeper... She likes apple pies very much, so I was thinking that we could have some together the next time she came over.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's a great idea! I'm sure Honami's gonna really love it when she hears that you bought them for her, K.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Gimme one second. I remember writing down the names of some really good places that sell apple pies and tarts.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I think I know a good place too. Lemme look it up!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Aha! Found it... Okay, this specialty shop on Main Street's gotta be my top recommendation!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, that place! I've had their apple pie before! It was sooo good!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A specialty shop...? I had no idea...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <They seem to get a lot of repeat customers because you get to choose how cinnamon-y the crust is, and if you want cocoa powder and other stuff on it!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <They only use the best ingredients, and you can buy ones that are fresh out of the oven.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Lemme post the URL in chat.
Here...!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The picture of the bag they have on their website... It looks familiar...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think Ms. Mochizuki brought some apple pies over from this shop before.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Darn. I guess it's only natural for an apple pie lover like her to know about this shop.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... If that's the case, she might know about all of the other shops in town.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You kinda want to surprise her with an apple pie from a place she's never been to before, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah... Alright, then, how about this one?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It just opened up by the station, and everyone's talking about how crispy they make their crusts!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh... We had some together from this shop just last week...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Grr... Strike two!
I'll admit, she is quick.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<K, how about here?
It's inside the shopping mall...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's every apple pie shop in Shibuya...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sorry, K, I wish we could actually help...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, that's okay. If anything, I should be the one apologizing for making you two look up all these shops...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I really appreciate you finding them for me since I couldn't remember the names of some of these places despite having their apple pies.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'll try buying some from the first shop you showed me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I hope Honami likes what you get for her.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness I was able to buy these apple pies...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was worried that they'd sell out after seeing that massive line coming out of the store.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that ended up taking longer than I was expecting. I should get home before Ms. Mochizuki arrives.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hm? Ms. Yoisaki?
Were you out just now?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I was out buying something.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That bag. It's from the apple pie shop on Main Street, yes? Were you out buying...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, some of their apple pies.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're always doing so much for me, so I thought that I could give back to you somehow today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, you didn't need to do that...!
I'm just doing my job.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That may be so, but I can't thank you enough for always cooking delicious food and cleaning my room for me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, let's have some of these apple pies together when it's snack time.
